title: Accelerating Time Series Foundation Models with Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2511.18191v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series forecasting drives operational decisions under tight latency budgets, and autoregressive time series foundation models (TSFMs) increasingly deliver the most accurate forecasts. That accuracy is paid for at inference, since a horizon of $H$ steps takes $\lceil H / P\rceil$ sequential forward passes of a large model, so latency grows with exactly the long horizons these models are prized for. Yet a far cheaper model predicts most next patches nearly as well as the large one, and causal models can verify a block of future patches in one parallel pass even though they generate them one at a time. These are precisely the conditions under which speculative decoding thrives in LLMs, but its ingredients are all defined over discrete vocabularies. translated_title: 利用推测解码加速时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.18191v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：时间序列预测在严格的延迟预算下驱动运营决策，而自回归时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）日益提供最准确的预测。这种准确性在推理时付出代价，因为预测范围H步需要大模型进行⌈H/P⌉次顺序前向传递，因此延迟随着这些模型备受推崇的长预测范围而增长。然而，一个便宜得多的模型几乎能像大模型一样预测大多数下一个补丁，而因果模型可以在一次并行传递中验证未来补丁块，尽管它们是一个接一个生成的。这些正是推测解码在大型语言模型（LLMs）中蓬勃发展的条件，但其要素都定义在离散词汇表上。因此，我们为连续补丁自回归开发了推测解码。一个廉价的草稿模型提出K个未来补丁，目标模型在单次因果传递中验证所有补丁，从而加速推理。
tldr: 本文首次将推测解码扩展到连续时间序列预测，通过廉价草稿模型提出多个未来补丁并由目标模型并行验证，显著降低长预测范围下的推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers speculative decoding for continuous time series forecasting, where a cheap draft model proposes multiple future patches verified in parallel by the target model, substantially reducing inference latency for long horizons.
